craft_notes: Sthāyin: Wonder at all-containing, marveled into refuge. Comma→dash (apportioning held, hail released). Rejected: 'unseen' for 'unwitnessed' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: To the hungerless apportioner of hungers numberless —
the world's unwitnessed dawn-dweller and devourer, Bhava, take hail of me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: niṣkāmāyāpi kāmānām anantānāṃ vidhāyine anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te

reads_against.argmap: To desireless yet ordainer of endless desires. → Bow to desireless ordainer and enjoyer.
c1_essence: Want-free apportioner of endless wants, beginningless world's feaster.

l2.plain_english: Hail the hungerless apportioner of hunger without end; though the world never began, its feaster — Bhava, take my bow.
l2.sanskrit_cite: niṣkāmāyāpi kāmānām anantānāṃ vidhāyine anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te

l3: To the hungerless apportioner of hungers numberless,

reads_against.t1: To desireless yet ordainer of endless desires; even in world's beginninglessness, to enjoyer — O Bhava, let bow be to you.
